entries.660ad679e04520bf: The long-term vision is "a company that conveys the joy of making things," and the medium-term management plan "Move! 2027," covering the fiscal years from the year ended March 2026 to the year ending March 2028, takes "sustainable growth for the next 100 years" as its basic policy. In the Household Equipment Business, the company aims to establish and strengthen its brand identity and expand market share through product launches; in the Industrial Equipment Business, it aims to focus on key markets and strengthen sales of high value-added products; and in the IT-Related Business, it aims to strengthen collaboration with other businesses and maintain the profitability of existing businesses. The medium-term management plan also sets performance targets for its final fiscal year, but the numerical figures are not stated here due to the rules governing this text.
